scope: Actual first-stage execution feedback window; not continuous visibility or release acceptance; cleanup ACK.mode exception prevents release claim

motion_window.source: Owner/probe first EXECUTING feedback through first FIRST_STAGE_HOLD_CONFIRMED feedback
motion_window.acceptance: Execution feedback interval, not release completion

method.source_interval: Adjacent received header stamps; not direct acquisition history
method.receive_interval: Adjacent receive_monotonic_ns; gap>250ms uses strict integer comparison
method.motion_boundary: Interior gaps computed from samples received within feedback window; boundary silence and intersecting gaps reported separately
method.health_age: latest observed /clock minus data.capture_stamp; same epoch/capture steady age is not acquisition latency
method.incomplete: Owned SIGINT exit130 means INCOMPLETE; no 300s sampling PASS
